headline: Страны Центральной Азии готовят единую площадку для торговли электричеством
summary: Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan and Tajikistan are preparing to launch a unified electricity market. The coordination dispatch centre Energiya has announced a selection process.
why: Cross-border electricity trading lets countries balance supply and demand and price power more efficiently. Such markets can attract investment in generation and transmission across the region.
